name: Croft

modes.label: Team app hosting (flat monthly fee per plan)
modes.note: Flat monthly fee covers hosting for unlimited AI-built apps on your private Croft server; no per-second, per-token, or per-app metering. Solo plan: up to 10 users can access your apps. Team plan: up to 50 users, multiple app builders, roles/permissions. Enterprise: unlimited users, larger servers, data residency. No published vCPU/RAM specs. Not a general-purpose VM/sandbox provider - designed for hosting internal team apps built with AI assistants, with integrated SSO, access controls, and governance.

plans.name: Solo
plans.note: $24/month billed yearly ($288/yr). One person builds apps. Share apps with up to 10 people. Includes SSO with passkeys, automatic backups, zero-downtime deploys, connectors to Stripe/HubSpot/45+ tools, shared data across apps. 7-day free trial, no card required.

plans.name: Team
plans.note: $99/month billed yearly ($1,188/yr). Multiple people can build apps. Up to 50 people total. Includes everything in Solo plus roles/permissions (admins, creators, members), team controls for shared data and connectors, full access audit trail. 7-day free trial.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Custom pricing. Unlimited people, larger servers and more capacity, choose hosting region (data residency), full change log and audit export, priority support and onboarding.

caveats: Croft is NOT a general-purpose VM/sandbox provider like E2B or Railway Sandboxes. It is a PaaS for hosting AI-built internal team apps with integrated SSO, access controls, and governance.
Pricing is a flat monthly fee per plan with no per-second, per-token, or per-app metering. Not suitable for metered agent workload pricing comparisons.
No published compute specifications (vCPU, RAM, disk) for the underlying servers. Enterprise plan offers 'larger servers' but specifics require sales contact.
The product is designed for apps built by AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, Cursor) over MCP, not for arbitrary code execution or agent sandboxes.
Apps are deployed to a private 'croft' server with a shared login page; individual apps cannot be independently scaled or sized.
User limits: Solo up to 10 people can access apps, Team up to 50 people, Enterprise unlimited. These are access limits, not builder limits (except Solo is 1 builder).
All plans include automatic backups, monitoring, versioning/rollback, zero-downtime deploys, and connectors to 45+ services (Stripe, HubSpot, etc.).
7-day free trial available on Solo and Team plans, no card required to start.
Export feature allows taking all apps, data, and code when canceling (packaged to run anywhere Docker does).
Compute isolation, root access, SSH, custom images, Docker-in-Docker, and typical sandbox features are not documented and assumed unavailable.
Suited for use cases like internal dashboards, approval queues, team rosters, quote calculators, not for running untrusted code or ephemeral agent workloads.

fleet.verification: No card required for 7-day trial; card required to continue after trial.
fleet.tiers: Solo: 1 builder, up to 10 users can access apps. Team: multiple builders, up to 50 users. Enterprise: unlimited users, larger servers.
fleet.notes: Limits are on user access and builder count, not on number of apps or compute instances. Number of apps you can deploy is not explicitly capped on any plan.

sso.quote: Your apps sit behind your login page before a single line of their code runs. Your data stays with your team. Access is yours to control.
sso.note: Enterprise-grade single sign-on with passkeys built into every plan. All apps share one company login page.

inbound_https.quote: Your own secure address on oncroft.net
inbound_https.note: Apps are served over HTTPS at oncroft.net subdomain addresses.

scheduled_wakeups.quote: Apps that work while you sleep. Give any app a schedule, or an event to react to. Connect your own AI and it can read, summarise, and decide - a morning briefing, a nightly sync, a report that just arrives.
scheduled_wakeups.note: Apps can be scheduled to run at specific times or in response to events.

audit_logs.note: Team plan includes full access audit trail; Enterprise includes 'A full change log & audit export'.

credential_injection.quote: Your apps can reach Stripe, your CRM, email services, and any API — with the keys held safely by Croft, never in the app code. Sensitive sources require admin approval, with a full audit trail.
credential_injection.note: Credentials/API keys for connectors are held by the platform and injected into apps, not stored in app code. Governance controls for sensitive connectors.

ingress_rules.quote: Choose who can open which apps. Remove someone once, they're out of everything.
ingress_rules.note: Per-app access controls; administrators choose which users can access which apps.

persistent_disk.quote: Every app's data is backed up continuously to separate storage - and we practise restoring it. A backup nobody has tested is just a hope, so we test ours.
persistent_disk.note: Apps have persistent databases and file storage, continuously backed up.

mcp_server.quote: Croft speaks MCP - the common language AI assistants use to work with outside tools. Paste your croft's connection link into Claude, ChatGPT, or Grok once, and it can build straight onto your croft.
mcp_server.note: Croft provides an MCP connection endpoint for AI assistants to connect TO it and build apps, but Croft itself is not listed as providing an MCP server that other tools consume. The feature is reversed: you connect your assistant to Croft via MCP, not Croft exposing an MCP server.

self_host.note: Croft provides a managed private server per customer, but there is no option to self-host the Croft platform on your own infrastructure. It is a managed service.

open_source.quote: Croft is private, secure hosting for vibe-coded apps a business actually runs.
open_source.note: Croft is a commercial, closed-source managed platform. No indication of open-source code.

locations_note: Enterprise plan offers choice of hosting region for data residency; specific regions not listed on public pages.
